datasets.name: Commission
datasets.sql:
select
    id
   ,name
   ,debt
  
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(debt) as DebitAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(debt) as DebitCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(debt) as DebitCurrencyID
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetCurrencyName(debt) as DebitValute
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetValuteName(debt) as DebitValuteName
  ,credit

   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(credit) as CreditCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountval_name(credit) as CreditValuteName
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(credit) as CreditCurrencyID   
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountName(credit) as Creditname  
   ,additionalDebt
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalDebt) as ADebitAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalDebt) as ADebitCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(additionalDebt) as AddDebitCurrencyID      
   ,additionalCredit
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountnumber(additionalCredit) as ACreditAccount
   ,sb_complex_transactions.GetAccountCurrency(additionalCredit) as ACreditCurrency
   ,sb_complex_transactions.getaccountcurrencyid(additionalCredit) as AddCreditCurrencyID         
   ,assignment
   ,commisionassignment
   ,UserID 

from
    commision_trans
where
   UserID = 0 or
    UserID = (SBLogin.UserID)
order by
    name

datasets.name: DebetTransactionsData
datasets.sql:
select
  p.ID,
  p.debt as DebitAccID,
  p.dat as OperationDate,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.ammount_c as CreditAmount,
  p.lammount as LAmount,
  ac.acc_no as CreditAccNo,
  ac.name as Creditname,
  p.NAME as Destination,
  am.val_name as d_valute
from
  SMART.provarch p,
  SMART.account ac,
  SMART.avalute_t am
where
  (p.dat between :StartDate and :EndDate)
  and (p.debt = :AccountID)
  and (ac.id = p.kredit)
  and (am.valute=ac.val_acc)
 
order by p.dat

from

datasets.name: Transaction
datasets.sql:
--select c.rowid,c.* from transaction c
SELECT
  P.rowid,
  p.ID,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,(select substr(ad.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as D_Accno,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,(select substr(ac.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as C_Accno,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.commit_opid) as usrcommit ,
  0 as Flags,
  2 as status,
  '' as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid

FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    provarch p
where
   /* p.dat =:TransactionDate and p.id=:trid
    and */(ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
          not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
          or
          (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

union 

SELECT
  P.rowid,
  p.ID,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,(select substr(ad.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as D_Accno,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,(select substr(ac.ACC_NO,9,20) from dual)as C_Accno,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  sb_aca.getuserbyid(p.op_id) as usr ,
  '' as usrcommit ,

  0 as Flags,
  decode(Rejected, 0, 1, 3) as status,
  RejectReason as REJECT_REASON,
  p.reportid,
  p.countrid


FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    LAZYTRANSACTION p
where
    /*p.dat =:TransactionDate and p.id=:trid
    and*/ (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
        not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
        or
        (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

--Order by :Title

datasets.name: ODSTransactionsViewer
datasets.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  PR.DAT,PR.ID as ID
 ,AC1.ACC_NO AS DEBIT,AC1.KLI_ID AS DEBTID,AC1.FILIAL as DebetFilial
 ,AC1.NAME AS DNAME,AC2.KLI_ID AS KREDITID
 ,PR.VAL_ACC AS DCURRENCY, sb_complex_transactions.GetCurrencyName(PR.VAL_ACC) as DebtCurName
 ,AC2.ACC_NO AS KREDIT,AC1.KLI_ID,AC2.FILIAL as CreditFilial
 ,AC2.NAME  AS  KNAME
 ,AC1.BAL_CN1 AS DEBTCOME
 ,AC2.BAL_CN1 AS CREDITCOME
 ,PR.CURRENCYID_C AS KCURRENCY, sb_complex_transactions.GetCurrencyName(PR.CURRENCYID_C) as CreditCurName
 ,PR.AMMOUNT  AS DAMMOUNT
 ,PR.AMMOUNT_C AS KAMMOUNT
 ,PR.LAMMOUNT AS LAMMOUNT
 ,PR.KASSA_B AS BSYMBOL, PR.NO_PROV
 ,PR.OP_ID AS OperatorID
 ,PR.NAME AS ASSIGNMENT
 FROM  PROVARCH PR,ACCOUNT AC1,ACCOUNT AC2
      ,BAL_SPR1 REFERENCE
 WHERE
        AC1.ID=PR.DEBT
    AND AC2.ID=PR.KREDIT
    AND PR.DAT>=:FIRSTDATE
    AND PR.DAT<=:LASTDATE

    AND REFERENCE.CASHINCOMING=1

    ORDER BY  :Title

datasets.name: Transactions
datasets.sql:
SELECT
  p.ID,
  P.rowid,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  0 as Flags,
  2 as status,
  '' as REJECT_REASON
FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    provarch p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (ad.val_acc = p.val_acc)
    and (ac.val_acc = p.CurrencyID_C)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
--    and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
  --        not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
    --      or
      --    (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))

union all

SELECT
  p.ID,
  P.rowid,
  p.OP_ID as OperatorID,
  p.no_prov as OperationNo,
  p.dat as TransactionDate,
  p.DEBT as DebitID,
  ad.ACC_NO as DebitAccNo,
  p.VAL_ACC as DebitCurrencyID,
  dc.val_name as DebitCurrencySName,
  ad.filial as DebitBranch,
  p.KREDIT as CreditID,
  ac.ACC_NO as CreditAccNo,
  p.CurrencyID_C as CreditCurrencyID,
  cc.val_name as CreditCurrencySName,
  ac.filial as CreditBranch,
  p.ammount as DebitAmount,
  p.Ammount_C as CreditAmount,
  p.LAmmount as LAmount,
  p.Rate_D as DebitRate,
  p.Rate_C as CreditRate,
  p.Bank_D as DebitBank,
  p.Bank_K as CreditBank,
  p.NO_PACK as PackageNumber,
  p.SHIFR as CYPHERCODE,
  sb_expertanalyse.getoperationtype(p.vid_op, p.val_acc, p.currencyID_c) as OPERATIONCODE,
  p.Kassa_B as INBALANCECHAR,
  p.Kassa_Z as OUTBALANCECHAR,
  p.NO_FILIAL as FilialID,
  ad.bal_cn1 as DebitBalance,
  p.Name,
  0 as Flags,
  decode(Rejected, 0, 1, 3) as status,
  RejectReason as REJECT_REASON
FROM
    account ad,
    account ac,
    avalute dc,
    avalute cc,
    LAZYTRANSACTION p
where
    p.dat =:TransactionDate
    and (ad.ID = p.DEBT)
    and (ac.ID = p.KREDIT)
    and (dc.VALUTE = p.val_acc)
    and (cc.VALUTE = p.CurrencyID_C)
  --  and ((P.OP_ID<>-1 and
    --      not EXISTS(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0)))
      --    or
        --  (P.OP_ID in(select SUSER from sba_userman where MUSER=uid and (type#=1 or type#=0))))
